COMAPA, Nuevo Laredo's municipal water utility, will suspend water service in the Valle Dorado sector on Thursday, November 5, from 8:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m., according to El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo.

The suspension is for electromechanical rehabilitation of the Valle Dorado repumping station, including connecting discharge lines, welding 8-inch and 14-inch pipes, and installing control valves, El Mañana reported. The work is being carried out by developer SM de México, in coordination with the Federal Electricity Commission and the municipal government through COMAPA and the Primary Public Services Secretariat.

The work is intended to improve water pressure in the Valle Dorado and Valle Elizondo colonias, according to El Mañana. The report did not state whether Valle Elizondo itself will lose service during the suspension, only that it is expected to benefit from improved pressure afterward.

COMAPA will provide tanker-truck service during the suspension, El Mañana reported. The report gave no phone number or procedure for requesting a tanker truck.

title: COMAPA to Suspend Water Service in Valle Dorado on Thursday, Nov. 5, for Pumping Station Work
